# Game Idea: Asteroid Dodge

- **Genre:** Endless arcade
- **Controls:** Arrow keys / WASD to move a ship vertically.
- **Goal:** Survive as long as possible by dodging randomly generated asteroids that scroll right‑to‑left across the canvas.
- **Lose condition:** Collision with any asteroid **or** an asteroid reaches the left edge of the canvas (the ship is crushed).

1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   // Audio setup
5:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
6:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
7:   // Simple beep generator
8:   function playBeep(freq, duration){
9:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:     osc.type = 'sine';
12:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
13:     osc.connect(gain);
14:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     osc.start();
16:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration/1000);
18:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration/1000);
19:   }
20:   // Background drone
21:   let droneOsc = null;
22:   function startDrone(){
23:     if(droneOsc) return;
24:     droneOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
25:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
26:     droneOsc.type = 'sawtooth';
27:     droneOsc.frequency.value = 40;
28:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
29:     droneOsc.connect(gain);
30:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
31:     droneOsc.start();
32:   }
33:   function stopDrone(){
34:     if(droneOsc){
35:       droneOsc.stop();
36:       droneOsc.disconnect();
37:       droneOsc = null;
38:     }
39:   }
40:   // Start audio on user interaction
41:   window.addEventListener('click',()=>{ if(audioCtx.state==='suspended') audioCtx.resume(); startDrone(); },{once:true});
42:   if(!canvas){ console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found'); return; }
43:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
44:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
45:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
46: 
47:   // Ship definition
48:   const ship = {x:50, y:height/2, w:30, h:20, dy:0, speed:4};
49: 
50:   // Starfield background
51:   const starCount = 120;
52:   const starSpeed = 0.3;
53:   const stars = [];
54:   for(let i=0;i<starCount;i++){
55:     stars.push({x:Math.random()*width, y:Math.random()*height, radius:Math.random()*1.5+0.5, twinkle:Math.random()});
56:   }
57:   const ship = {x:50, y:height/2, w:30, h:20, dy:0, speed:4};
58: 
59:   // Asteroid pool
60:   const asteroids = [];
61:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
62:   const asteroidSpeed = 2.5;
63: 
64:   let lastSpawn = 0, score = 0, prevScore = 0, startTime = performance.now(), gameOver = false;
65: 
66:   // Input handling
67:   const keys = {};
68:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key]=true});
69:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false});
70: 
71:   function update(dt){
72:     // Update star twinkle (simple pulsate)
73:     stars.forEach(s=>{
74:       s.twinkle += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
75:       if(s.twinkle<0) s.twinkle=0;
76:       if(s.twinkle>1) s.twinkle=1;
77:       // Move stars leftwards for parallax effect
78:       s.x -= starSpeed;
79:       if(s.x < 0) s.x = width;
80:     });
81:     // Ship movement (W/S or ArrowUp/Down)
82:     ship.dy = 0;
83:     if(keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w']||keys['W']) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
84:     else if(keys['ArrowDown']||keys['s']||keys['S']) ship.dy = ship.speed;
85:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height-ship.h, ship.y + ship.dy));
86: 
87:     // Asteroid spawn
88:     if(performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval){
89:       const radius = 15 + Math.random()*10;
90:       asteroids.push({x:width+radius, y:Math.random()*height, r:radius});
91:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
92:       // Play a subtle spawn sound
93:       playBeep(120, 80);
94:     }
95: 
96:     // Move asteroids and check collisions
97:     for(let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
98:       const a = asteroids[i];
99:       a.x -= asteroidSpeed;
100:       // Collision with ship (simple AABB vs circle)
101:       const shipRect = {x:ship.x, y:ship.y, w:ship.w, h:ship.h};
102:       const nearestX = Math.max(shipRect.x, Math.min(a.x, shipRect.x+shipRect.w));
103:       const nearestY = Math.max(shipRect.y, Math.min(a.y, shipRect.y+shipRect.h));
104:       const dx = a.x - nearestX, dy = a.y - nearestY;
105:       if(dx*dx+dy*dy < a.r*a.r){ if(!gameOver){ playBeep(350,150); stopDrone(); } gameOver = true; }
106:       // Asteroid reaches left edge (crush)
107:       if(a.x - a.r <= 0) gameOver = true;
108:       // Remove off‑screen
109:       if(a.x + a.r < 0) asteroids.splice(i,1);
110:     }
111:     if(!gameOver) score = Math.floor((performance.now()-startTime)/1000);
112:   }
113: 
114:   function draw(){
115:     // Background cleared by filling black in ship draw section
116:     // Background
117:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000010';
118:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
119:     // Starfield
120:     stars.forEach(s=>{
121:       const alpha = 0.5 + s.twinkle * 0.5;
122:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
123:       ctx.beginPath();
124:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI*2);
125:       ctx.fill();
126:     });
127:     // Ship (triangle) with gradient
128:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.x+ship.w, ship.y+ship.h);
129:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
130:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003300');
131:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
132:     ctx.beginPath();
133:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h/2);
134:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
135:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
136:     ctx.closePath();
137:     ctx.fill();
138:     // Asteroids with gradient shading
139:     asteroids.forEach(a=>{
140:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r*0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
141:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
142:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
143:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
144:       ctx.beginPath();
145:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
146:       ctx.fill();
147:     });
148:     // Score
149:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
150:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
151:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+score, 10, 20);
152:     if(gameOver){
153:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
154:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
155:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
156:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
157:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
158:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2, height/2);
159:     }
160:   }
161: 
162:   function loop(timestamp){
163:     if(!gameOver){
164:       const dt = timestamp - (lastRender||timestamp);
165:       update(dt);
166:     }
167:     draw();
168:     lastRender = timestamp;
169:     if(!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
170:   }
171:   let lastRender;
172:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
173: })();

(End of file - total 173 lines)
</content>
